question: What foundational status does Mātṛkā hold in relation to knowledges and āgamas?
premises: She is the mother of all knowledges.
She is established in all āgamas.
inference: Mātṛkā is the maternal source of all knowledge and the foundation of all āgamic traditions.
plain_english: She is the mother of all knowledges, established in all the āgamas.
